content.short: Rocket Pool Subgraph indexes on-chain Rocket Pool protocol data for actionable insights.
content.description: The Rocket Pool Subgraph is a collaborative effort by Rocket Pool and Graph protocol community members. It indexes on-chain data from Rocket Pool activities, assembling a comprehensive record of staking events, pool compositions, and rewards. Through a GraphQL API, the Subgraph makes it possible for developers to query and extract insights about stakeholder balances and earned rewards by monitoring staking pools and their associated transactions across Ethereum, Solana, OP Mainnet, and Polygon.
